src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Which organization signed an MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Government in 2025 to improve health, education and agriculture using technology?
x: The AP government's 2025 partnership with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation uses technology (AI, data, digital public infrastructure) to improve health, education and agriculture; the Foundation is also a partner of Project Sanjeevani. WHO, NITI Aayog and Tata Trusts were not the 2025 MoU partner.

src: APPSC
s: What is the upper limit of free treatment coverage provided under the new hybrid model of NTR Vaidya Seva announced in January 2025 in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Under the hybrid model announced in January 2025, insurance covers claims up to ₹2.5 lakh and the Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust funds treatment from ₹2.5 lakh up to ₹25 lakh per family. So the upper limit is ₹25 lakh; ₹10, ₹15 and ₹20 lakh are wrong.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s:
Consider the following statements about the NTR Vaidya Seva Scheme Model of Andhra Pradesh and select the correct option.
Statement 1: The new insurance model will provide health coverage of up to 25 lakh per family annually.
Statement 2: Both public and private insurers will be utilised under this model to ensure broader health coverage for families.
o: Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct.
Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are incorrect.
x: Both are correct: the new NTR Vaidya Seva hybrid model covers up to ₹25 lakh per family a year, and it uses insurers (public and private) for claims up to ₹2.5 lakh while the Trust bears ₹2.5–25 lakh.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: Which State Government is set to introduce Saheli Smart Card to enable free bus travel for women?
x: The (Pink) Saheli Smart Card, an NCMC tap-and-go card for free DTC and cluster bus travel by women and transgender persons, is a Delhi government scheme (2025). Andhra Pradesh's free bus scheme is Stree Shakti (from 15 August 2025), and Telangana's is Mahalakshmi.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: What is the primary objective of the 'Stree Shakti' Scheme launched by the Andhra Pradesh government?
o: To provide free healthcare services to women
To offer free bus travel to women across the state
To distribute financial aid to women entrepreneurs
x: Stree Shakti (Super Six promise) gives free APSRTC bus travel to girls, women and transgender persons across the State from 15 August 2025. It is not a healthcare, financial-aid or empowerment-centre scheme.

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: What is the primary goal of the P4 Program of Andhra Pradesh Government?
o: Developing Andhra Pradesh as IT Hub
x: P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership, launched Ugadi 30 March 2025) aims at complete eradication of poverty ('Zero Poverty'), linked to SDG 1. It is not a family-planning, IT-hub or mother-and-child health programme.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Who was appointed by the Andhra Pradesh government as the head of the one-man commission to examine sub-classification within Scheduled Castes (SCs)?
x: AP appointed retired IAS officer Rajiv Ranjan Mishra as the one-man commission on SC sub-classification (G.O.Ms.No.86, 15 Nov 2024, under the Commission of Inquiry Act, 1952, after the SC's 1 August 2024 verdict); his report (10 March 2025) put the 59 SCs into three groups, implemented by ordinance in April 2025.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: Which district in Andhra Pradesh became the first to have 100% CCTV camera coverage?
x: NTR district (Vijayawada Police Commissionerate, CP S.V. Rajashekhar Babu) became the first in AP to have 100% CCTV coverage, with at least four cameras in each of its 305 inhabited villages (2025). Guntur, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati are not the answer.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: Polam Pilustondi programme of Andhra Pradesh Government aims at
x: Polam Pilustondi ('the field is calling'), launched in 2014, sends agriculture officials and scientists to villages to create awareness among farmers on profitable, low-cost, high-yield farming. It is an extension (awareness) campaign, not an investment, volunteering or farm-tourism programme.

src: Previous paper (title page not in scan)
s: As per the U-DISE data of Government of Andhra Pradesh, the number of schools in Andhra Pradesh are about (choose the nearest figure)?
x:
Printed key: 61,500. U-DISE+ 2024-25 (provisional) gives 58,572 schools, only marginally nearer 61,500 than 55,500 (Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25 p.183).
U-DISE+ puts Andhra Pradesh's schools at roughly 60,000 (58,572 in the provisional 2024-25 data, slightly higher in earlier years), so 61,500 is the nearest option (printed key). 51,500 and 71,500 are far off.

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: In January 2022, the Andhra Pradesh government announced an increase in the retirement age for its employees from 60 to ____ years.
x: On 7 January 2022 CM Jagan announced the 11th PRC (23% fitment) and raised the retirement age of State government employees from 60 to 62; the ordinance (31 Jan 2022) took effect from 1 January 2022. 60 was the earlier age (raised from 58 in 2014).

src: APPSC Civil Assistant Surgeon, Group-IV and Other Posts Gene
s: Andhra Pradesh government in January, 2022 has set the retirement age for Government Employees and Staff Members to ____.
x: On 7 January 2022 CM Jagan announced the 11th PRC (23% fitment) and raised the retirement age of State government employees from 60 to 62; the ordinance (31 Jan 2022) took effect from 1 January 2022. 60 was the earlier age (raised from 58 in 2014).

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer (Mains) General Studies &
s: Which of the following is NOT authorised to use Andhra Pradesh Government State Emblem?
o: Head of Autonomous bodies of government
x: The AP emblem order (14 Nov 2018) lets the CM, Ministers, Chief Secretary, Secretaries, the Advocate General, HoDs and Collectors use the multi-coloured emblem, and District HoDs the blue version; heads of autonomous bodies are not authorised.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: The Central Government has made a decision to continue support for development of the backward districts of which state?
x: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 (Sec. 46(2)-(3), 94) the Centre gives a special development package to the backward districts of the residuary State (7 districts of Rayalaseema and north coastal AP, ₹50 crore each a year), so the decision to continue it concerns Andhra Pradesh.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Ward Sanitation & Envir
s: The Government of Andhra Pradesh has provided an Act to treat the employees of the Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation on a par with those in State Government Sector. This Act is
o: The Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (Absorption of Employees into Government Service) Act, 2019
The Regional Transport Equality of Opportunity Act, 2019
x: The AP State Road Transport Corporation (Absorption of Employees into Government Service) Act, 2019 (Act 36 of 2019; Bill passed 16 Dec 2019) absorbed about 51,500 APSRTC staff into a new Public Transport Department from 1 January 2020. The other titles are not real Acts.

src: APPSC Endowment (Prelims) General Studies 2022
s: Which of the following is not a duty of the Executive Officer under the provisions of the A.P. Endowments Act (Act 30/87)?
x: Under Sec. 29(3) of the AP Charitable and Hindu Religious Institutions and Endowments Act, 1987, the Executive Officer keeps custody of records, accounts, jewels and funds, collects income and incurs expenditure, sues and is sued, deposits money and may order emergency works for the safety of pilgrims; 'publication of institutions' is not among his duties.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers 2020
s: As per the new sand policy of September 2019, which agency has been tasked with operating stockyards in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The sand policy of September 2019 (from 5 Sep 2019) made the AP Mineral Development Corporation (APMDC) mine sand and sell it at government stockyards at about ₹370 a tonne, ending the free-sand policy.

src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officer, Town Planning
s: In which city is the AP Human Resource Development Institute located?
x: The AP Human Resource Development Institute (APHRDI), the State's apex training institute for officials, functions at Bapatla (Dr MCR HRD Institute stayed with Telangana in Hyderabad).

src: APPSC Deputy Educational Officer Screening Test General Stud
s: The "Janmabhoomi-Maa Vooru" program in Andhra Pradesh encourages citizen participation in local governance and development. When the third phase of it was launched?
x: The third round of Janmabhoomi–Maa Vooru, themed 'Smart Village – Smart Ward towards Smart Andhra Pradesh', ran from 2 to 10/11 January 2016 (earlier rounds: Oct 2014, Jun 2015; fourth round Jan 2017).

src: APPSC AE (Environmental) Mains General Studies & Mental Abil
s: Chief minister of which state launched the "Smart Water Distribution Monitoring" web portal on 23rd November 2016, to enable the people to track the status of drinking water in the nearby water tanks?
x: CM N. Chandrababu Naidu launched the 'Smart Water Distribution Monitoring' web interface (SCADA-based, Vijayawada Municipal Corporation, on ourvmc.org) in November 2016 so people can check water levels in nearby tanks.

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: Which of the following is the first state in India to apply algorithms and data-science in public policy?
x: Andhra Pradesh (RTGS, e-Pragati, data lake under CM Naidu) is keyed as the first State to apply algorithms and data science in public policy; Delhi, Telangana and Tamil Nadu are not.

src: APPSC Asst. Director of Fisheries in A.P. Fisheries Service
s: Out of the below given, Which district is declared as open defecation free in the last week of April, 2017?
x: West Godavari is keyed as the district declared open-defecation-free in late April 2017; it had been targeted for ODF status from December 2016 (Nallajerla mandal ODF in Oct 2016), while East Godavari and Prakasam were reported ODF later in 2017.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: The Kutumba Vikasam programme of the AP State Government has
x: AP's integrated outcome-monitoring framework (2016-17 on) measures family-level development through 15 Kutumba Vikasam themes and community-level development through 10 Samaja Vikasam themes.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: Samaja Vikasam programme of the AP State Government has
x: Samaja Vikasam (community level) has 10 themes (quality education, health security, agriculture, industry, services, 24x7 power, roads, IT, citizen services, inclusive development); Kutumba Vikasam (family level) has 15.

src: APPSC AEE Screening Test 2016
s: How many sectoral missions are established by the Government of Andhra Pradesh as part of the mission based developmental strategy?
x: Under its 2014 mission-based strategy (Vision 2029), AP set up seven sectoral missions (primary sector, social empowerment, knowledge & skill development, urban development, industry, infrastructure, services) besides five grids and five campaigns.

src: Previous paper (title page not in scan)
s: Which of the following is the name of one of the five campaigns of Government of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The Naidu government's (2014–19) development plan had seven missions, five grids and five campaigns; the five campaigns were Polam Pilustondi, Badi Pilustondi, Pedarikam Pai Gelupu (victory over poverty), Swachh Andhra Pradesh and Neeru-Chettu. Jala Siri, Panta Sanjivani and Arogya Raksha were not among the five campaigns.

src: APPSC Lecturers in Govt Degree Colleges Paper-I General Stud
s: Who among the following is the Minister of Environment, Forest, Science, and Technology in Andhra Pradesh as of April 2025?
x: Deputy CM Konidela Pawan Kalyan holds Panchayat Raj, Rural Development, Rural Water Supply, Environment, Forests, Science and Technology (portfolios allotted 14 June 2024). Nara Lokesh holds HRD/IT, Ponguru Narayana MA&UD and Satya Kumar Yadav Health.

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: In the Andhra Pradesh's new cabinet formation in April 2022, which of the following Ministers is a first-time legislator?
x: Gudivada Amarnath (Anakapalli) entered the Assembly for the first time in 2019 and became Industries & IT Minister in the reconstituted cabinet of 11 April 2022; Peddireddy Ramachandra Reddy, K. Narayana Swamy and Taneti Vanitha had been MLAs before 2019.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: As of December 2019, who was the DGP of Andhra Pradesh?
x:
Sawang left in February 2022 — now Harish Kumar Gupta is DGP (Praveen CA-360 Feb 2026 magazine p.66)
Damodar Gautam Sawang became AP DGP on 1 June 2019 (regular from Aug 2019) and served until 15 Feb 2022, when he was made APPSC Chairman. Harish Kumar Gupta is a later DGP.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Who among the following is NOT a Deputy Chief Minister in the present Andhra Pradesh Government?
x:
the 2019 YSRCP cabinet was reshuffled (2020, April 2022) and replaced in June 2024 — now K. Pawan Kalyan is Deputy CM (businesstoday.in portfolio list, 14 Jun 2024; sole Deputy CM: general knowledge)
When this was asked (early 2020), Jagan's five Deputy CMs were Pilli Subhash Chandra Bose, Alla Kali Krishna Srinivas (Alla Nani), K. Narayana Swamy, Pamula Pushpa Sreevani and Amzath Basha; Dharmana Krishna Das (R&B) was not one (he became Deputy CM only in July 2020).

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) / Technical Assistan
s: Who is the present Cheif Secretary of the State of Andhra Pradesh?
x:
the Chief Secretary has changed many times — now G. Sai Prasad (from 1 March 2026; extended, eletsonline/Deccan Chronicle 2026)
Ajeya Kallam was AP Chief Secretary for one month, 1–31 March 2017, between S.P. Tucker (to Feb 2017) and Dinesh Kumar (from April 2017); A.C. Punetha came in 2018. So the paper of that time keys Ajeya Kallam.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
s: Who is appointed as Home Minister of Andhra Pradesh state?
x:
Sucharitha was Home Minister 2019-22 — now Vangalapudi Anitha (since June 2024; general knowledge, not checked)
Mekathoti Sucharitha was AP's Home Minister in the first Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy cabinet (2019–22); Taneti Vanitha followed in April 2022.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: The Department of adult education launched the programme of ____ to achieve 100% literacy in Andhra Pradesh.
x: Akshara Andhra (G.O.Ms.No.37, 25 Nov 2025), run by the Adult Education Department in line with the Centre's ULLAS, aims at 100% adult literacy. Swarna Andhra is the Vision-2047 brand; Sakshara Andhra and Chaduvula Andhra are not the programme.

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper (General Studie
s: "Conquer Exam, Be a Warrior" app developed by which state government?
x: The 'Conquer Exam, Be a Warrior' exam-stress app was developed by IIPH Gandhinagar with the Gujarat Health Department's National Mental Health Programme and launched on 18 March 2019, inspired by PM Modi's book 'Exam Warriors'.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Prana Raksha web application has been developed by the Chittoor Police. The app has been designed
o: To track criminals and monitor petty offences
To save the lives of road accident victims and reach out to women in distress
To manage traffic violations in urban areas
x: Chittoor Police's Prana Raksha web application was meant to save the lives of road-accident victims (golden-hour help) and to reach women in distress. Criminal tracking, traffic challans and record digitisation are not its purpose.

To manage traffic violations in urban areas

src: APPSC
s: As of May 2025, what is the monthly expenditure by the Andhra Pradesh government on social security pensions? Note: For this question, discrepancy is found in question/answer. So,this question is ignored for all candidates.
x:
APPSC ignored this question for all candidates (discrepancy in question/answer). The figure closest to AP's 2025 monthly outlay (about ₹2,750 crore) is ₹2,758 crore.
AP spends about ₹2,750 crore a month on NTR Bharosa social security pensions in 2025 (₹2,750.96 crore released for 1 August 2025; about ₹33,000 crore a year), so ₹2,758 crore is the only option near the real figure. APPSC dropped the question for a discrepancy, so there is no official key.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: The 'SHRESTH' initiative, recently launched in August 2025 in Andhra Pradesh aims to improve which sector?
x: SHRESTH (State Health Regulatory Excellence Index), launched by the Union Health Ministry on 12 August 2025 and run by CDSCO, benchmarks and strengthens State drug regulatory systems, i.e. the health regulatory system. It is a national index covering AP too, not a digital, irrigation or roads scheme.

src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector General Studies & Me
s: Where was the CXO Round Table conference held by the Andhra Pradesh government in April 2021?
x: The CXO Round Table Conclave on IT and electronics (post-COVID recovery), addressed by IT Minister Mekapati Goutham Reddy, was held at Vijayawada on 2 April 2021.
